race.comment: POOR OL' JOHNY RAY (2) resumes from a spell for the in form Kristie Clark-Peoples stable after being bought out of Victoria. He has had some gear changes, and with Ryan Wiggins in the saddle being a strong lead, he will be ready to rumble fresh up. BACETTI (4) has been thereabouts in all 3 starts back from a spell, and with a dip in class here, she should go close to taking this out. KALAMIA KING (1) has raced his way into some good form, and he won't lack fitness dropping back from a middle distance to a mile. A good draw helps, and he can figure in the top 4 again. FASTEST CHOICE (6) just whacked away for third in a 6-horse field at the Sunshine Coast nearly 3 weeks ago. She can battle her way into the money here as well. SEATICFLASH (7) ran on late to finish fourth in a tougher maiden field at Eagle Farm nearly 3 weeks ago, and she is still in her first prep. A better draw should see her figure in the top 3 this time.
